_meta: Real neighborhood spatial-deficit research (1/2-mile and 1-mile radius asset reports). Each entry's target_volume_cuft assumes a 12ft baseline ceiling height for underground cassettes. Used by the excavation solver to match a puncture zone's volume against a real programmatic need.
_shade_meta: shade_target_pct applies only to surface-level/open program (green_space, sports_recreation); enrichment_civic entries are enclosed cassette program, so shade is not applicable. Basis and unverified-claim caveats: archive/memoryMachine/LA Shade & Park Standards — Source Links.md

programs.label: Green Space & Park Infrastructure
programs.shade_basis: City of LA Landscape Ordinance No. 170,978 — 50% canopy coverage at 10yr growth, applied by analogy from its parking-lot standard to general hardscape/park surface.

programs.label: Community Garden
programs.shade_basis: Perimeter/seating shade only — planting beds need direct sun, so full-canopy standards don't apply; 25% covers edges and rest areas.

programs.label: Soccer Field
programs.shade_basis: Sideline/spectator shade only — play surface itself must stay clear, consistent with no standard requiring shade over active field area.

programs.label: Public Gym
programs.shade_basis: Not applicable — enclosed structure, not an open shade surface.

programs.label: Skatepark
programs.shade_basis: Perimeter shade target; full overhead canopy avoided so cast shadow lines don't create tripping hazards on the skating surface.

programs.label: Volleyball Court
programs.shade_basis: Sideline/spectator shade only, same logic as soccer_field.
